exam.title: Specialist Officer Mock Exam — Sectional Timers

questions.question: Which of the following database isolation levels prevents dirty reads, non-repeatable reads, and phantom reads?
questions.explanation: Serializable is the highest isolation level and completely prevents dirty reads, non-repeatable reads, and phantom reads.

questions.question: In TCP/IP architecture, which protocol is responsible for mapping an IP address to a physical MAC address?
questions.explanation: Address Resolution Protocol (ARP) translates 32-bit IPv4 addresses into 48-bit MAC physical hardware addresses.

questions.question: Pointing to a photograph of a woman, Rahul said, "Her mother's only daughter is my mother." How is Rahul related to the woman?
questions.explanation: The woman's mother's only daughter is the woman herself. Since Rahul says "is my mother", Rahul is her son.

questions.question:
Statements: All computers are machines. All machines need electricity.
Conclusion I: All computers need electricity.
Conclusion II: All things that need electricity are computers.
questions.explanation: Since all computers are machines and all machines need electricity, all computers need electricity (Conclusion I follows). Conclusion II is an illicit conversion and does not follow.
